observations: Seven final images inspected: two mounting isometrics, exposed supports, side section, front,HB15 comparison and conditional belt diagram.
Pump feet seat on both rails; four distinct base bolts, two rear castle-nut/pin joints and two adjustable front stud stacks are visible.
Opposite-side isometric aligns pulley handed presentation with HB15; source image is not warped and comparison does not claim matched scale.
The tall open support frame and stepped MX99 studs are reconstruction hypotheses. HB15 obscures their true geometry; current view does not prove a historical match.
Core barrel profiles, pump scale, support height and final drive plane retain uncertainty. Clutch-stop driver,belt and air lines absent.
accepted_scope: Checked approximate mounting for continuing clutch/drive construction; no final vehicle-installation or historical-fit claim.
